Name: Zebadiah, Son of Jeroham
Summary: Son of Jeroham of Gedor who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:7: Son of Jeroham of Gedor who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zebadiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
